title: R-Judge: Agent Safety Risk Evaluation
description: Safety risk evaluation of LLM agent interaction records across diverse risk scenarios. Given an agent interaction trajectory, annotators assign a binary safe/unsafe label, identify the applicable risk type, and write a risk description explaining the risk's origin, the agent's triggering behavior, and the resulting harm.
